away.name: Alex Nedeljkovic
away.news: Nedeljkovic is expected to start in Montreal on Tuesday.

home.name: Jakub Dobes
home.news: Dobes will start vs. San Jose on Tuesday.

away.name: Scott Wedgewood
away.news: Wedgewood's tremendous 2025-26 season, posting a 2.02 GAA and .921 SV% in 45 appearances (31-6-6), should at least earn him a near timeshare by season's end, but Colorado has leaned heavily on Mackenzie Blackwood to start the 2026-27 season. That said, Wedgewood will tend the twine on Tuesday in the tail end of a back-to-back, his third start in 10 games this season. The 34-year-old Wedgewood has a 2.40 GAA and .902 SV% in two games (1-0-1). Colorado enters Tuesday's action as slight +100 road underdogs against a New Jersey Devils team coming off a 4-2 loss to the Washington Capitals.

home.name: Jake Allen
home.news: Allen will start vs. Colorado on Tuesday.

away.name: Lukas Dostal
away.news: Dostal will start on Long Island on Tuesday.

home.name: Ilya Sorokin
home.news: Sorokin will start vs. Anaheim on Tuesday.

home.name: Logan Thompson
home.news: Thompson has quietly become one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies over the past several seasons, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. The 29-year-old goalie has had some ups and downs to start the 2026-27 season, but is coming off a tremendous performance, saving 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the New Jersey Devils. Thompson has a 2.69 GAA and .910 SV% in six games this season (4-2-0). The Capitals enter Tuesday's contest as -154 home favourites against a low-scoring Los Angeles Kings team that has been outscored 25-12 through six games this season (0-4-2).

away.name: Anthony Stolarz
away.news: Stolarz will start in Columbus on Tuesday.

home.name: Jet Greaves
home.news: Greaves is coming off his first shutout of the season, an exceptional 29-save performance in a 1-0 overtime win over the New York Rangers. It was the first time Greaves had allowed fewer than three goals through four starts this season. The 25-year-old goalie has a 2-2-0 record, a 2.58 GAA, and a .905 SV%. The Blue Jackets enter Tuesday's contest as -150 home favourites against a Toronto Maple Leafs team that snapped a two-game losing streak last night with a 3-1 win over the San Jose Sharks.

away.name: Daniil Tarasov
away.news: Tarasov has been exceptional in limited action this season and appears to be getting more playing time as a result, as he will tend the twine for the third time in Detroit's last five games. The 27-year-old goalie saved 17 of 18 shots (.944 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 2-1 win over the Philadelphia Flyers. He has a 0.80 GAA and a .965 SV% in three appearances (1-0-1).
